teaser: Four place settings washed and stacked before the dishwasher even starts its cycle — that is the 4 in you and the ESFJ in you, working the same motion at once. The number builds; the type belongs. Crossed, they turn one instinct toward one end: a table that holds, a household that runs, a group that stays fed and stays steady. What is particular here is how little daylight sits between them. Most pairings carry a number and a type pulling at odd angles. Yours mostly pull the same direction, which makes the moments when they do not line up land harder than they would elsewhere.
